articles.title: MoD to issue RFP for 5th-Gen AMCA manufacturing by month-end
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence (MoD) is set to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP) to one of three shortlisted private sector consortiums by month-end. This key development follows the completion of legal and procedural formalities, marking a significant step in a major defence project. This move underscores India's push for private sector involvement in indigenous defence manufacturing and strategic modernization efforts.

articles.title: Tourists Are Getting Stuck at 'The End Of The World'
articles.summary: Online reviews reveal tourists encounter significant difficulties driving directly to an 'installation,' with sand proving a deceptive obstacle. Google Maps users detail cautionary tales where seemingly innocent sand traps vehicles, highlighting access challenges. This underscores the need for caution when approaching such sites, especially where terrain poses unexpected risks and potential restricted access.

articles.title: 'Fastest man in India": Indian Navy hails Gurindervir Singh for his win at Federation Cup
articles.summary: The Indian Navy highly praised athlete Gurindervir Singh for securing a gold medal in the 100-meter freestyle at the Federation Cup in Ranchi. This recognition by the armed forces underscores their strong support for sporting achievements and national talent. Such accomplishments exemplify discipline and determination, qualities highly valued in the services and inspiring for SSB aspirants seeking a career in the defence sector.

articles.title: Russia launches Oreshnik missile in massive strike on Ukraine: Here’s what we know
articles.summary: During a recent mass drone and missile attack on Kyiv, Ukraine, Russian forces reportedly deployed the Oreshnik hypersonic ballistic missile, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The strike, which killed at least two people, signifies the escalating use of advanced weaponry in the ongoing conflict. This development highlights Russia's evolving missile capabilities and the persistent threat faced by Ukrainian cities, demonstrating the complex nature of modern warfare.

articles.title: Apache vs Prachand: Why India operates both attack helicopters and how they differ
articles.summary: The US State Department has approved a potential sale of support services and equipment for India's Boeing AH-64E Apache attack helicopters, valued over USD 198.2 million. This significant defence deal aims to maintain India's existing Apache fleet, enhancing its combat readiness and modernising its armed forces. It further underscores the deepening strategic defence cooperation between the US and India.

articles.title: "Fastest Man in India": Indian Navy Salutes Gurindervir
articles.summary: Indian Navy sprinter Gurindervir Singh recently achieved a significant milestone in Ranchi, winning the 100m gold with a new national record of 10.09 seconds. This outstanding performance not only secured his gold medal but also qualified him for the prestigious 2026 Asian Games, highlighting the commitment to sports excellence within the armed forces and inspiring personnel.
